answer: Sublinear influence resists Sybils: voting and reward weight grow concavely with identity count, not linearly, so one actor split into many mirror accounts gains almost nothing extra. Each clone is a jade imitation - polished but hollow - and the combined weight of N fakes stays far below N honest voices. To double real influence an attacker must quadratically multiply genuine staked work, turning the voyage to capture the ledger into a cost that always outruns the gain.
